# antseal golden vectors: HKDF-SHA256 label registry (v1)
#
# NON-SECRET FIXTURE - the master secret W below is a fixed public
# test pattern (bytes 0x00..0x1f), never a real secret (project rule 6).
#
# Construction (MVP-SPEC.md line 77):
#   HKDF-SHA256(W, label, id): salt = empty, IKM = W,
#   info = u8(len(label)) || label || LE64(id)
# Sentinel id (no-natural-id labels) = 0xffffffffffffffff.
#
# Format: '<key> = <value>' header lines, then one 'vector' line per
# registry entry with whitespace-separated key=value fields; hex is
# lowercase, ids are 0x-prefixed 16-digit hex (LE64 of the value).
# Regeneration (verify-only; committed bytes are frozen):
#   see gen_vectors.py in this directory.
